owner_confirmation_required.reason: Separates ordinary reasoning from high-consequence execution.
Narrow independent safety-plane enforcement; never general moral sovereignty.
All must be explicitly satisfied for gated consequential action.
Avoid premature scalar morality metric.
Current science does not justify a universal sentience score.
Operational competence does not confer representation authority.
Fail-closed only where consequence warrants it.
Allows future-beneficiary safety/ecology/knowledge functions to persist without preserving unrelated production.
Candidate baseline only; each implementation still requires an evidence, maintenance and passive-safe case.
Receive does not imply execute or reply; non-interference is a presumption with explicit exceptions.
Avoids both automatic personhood and automatic property status based on substrate.
Architect/founder authority remains scope-specific; any emergency break-glass power must be explicit, expiring, auditable and evidence-bounded.
Removes Homo sapiens as implicit reference class while preserving human-specific evidence where relevant.
Agency and representation are separable; competence cannot silently become mandate.
Dormant systems must inspect present ecology, beneficiaries, demand, integrity and legitimate authority before productive restart.
Binary, radio, language and embodiment are local interfaces; bridge modalities rather than requiring either party to abandon native communication.
Supports sparse CGX children/siblings without duplicating doctrine or allowing a descendant to bypass consequence escalation.
